item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 09/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front is expected to form over the northern part of southern China tomorrow, and will move across the coast of Guangdong later tomorrow. Under the influence of the associated dry northeast monsoon, it will be slightly cooler in the morning over southern China and the weather will improve. A southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will be hot during the day with a few showers over the region.

Weather: Cloudy with occasional showers and a few squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavier in some areas Temperatures beginning to fall at night.
